message: Preregistered one fresh n28.7m-label fixed-20k extension arm behind CR-TOK-0003. A CPU-only architecture probe established local parameter/FLOPs identity; no candidate training or held-out evaluation has started.
Bound the recorded runner, fixed periodic validation, W&B mirror configuration and aligned baseline comparison to an immutable source commit.
Prepared the detached DSW execution worktree and verified runtime dependencies. The arm remains queued until CR-TOK-0003 is terminal; no second GPU process was started.
Started the fresh n28.7m-label arm only after CR-TOK-0003 reached terminal state; W&B authentication preflight was unavailable, so the run truthfully used offline mode.
The first attempt exited before any optimizer update because validation DatasetConfig materialization required the omitted defaulted field mouse_repr.

After confirming the exact missing-default regression test failed, fixed validation config materialization and applied the code-only fix to the detached execution worktree. No model, data, budget or evaluation parameter changed; no checkpoint is reused.
Restarted attempt 02 from zero on the code-only bugfix execution commit. The scientific protocol is unchanged, W&B remains offline, and no prior checkpoint was reused.
